summary.content:
Today's selection covers 92 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: A.I. Companies Shatter Fund-Raising Records, as Boom Accelerates
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: New EvilTokens service fuels Microsoft device code phishing attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 43 articles published in the last 24 hours
